name: Furies
description: Seeking to avenge her father's death, a young woman becomes entangled in the web of the Fury, peacekeeper of the Paris criminal underworld.

videos.title: I work for her
videos.overview: As she vows to avenge her family after her birthday ends in bloodshed, Lyna edges closer to the one person she holds responsible: the Fury.

videos.title: Broken heart > Bullet in the head
videos.overview: With a police officer hot on her tail, Lyna's first mission sees her go deep undercover in Mama's bordello where a simple task turns very complicated.

videos.title: I'd never have bet on you
videos.overview: The Fury races to retrieve a missing safe ahead of the Writing Ceremony. Dynamics shift as Lyna grapples with disturbing news about her parents.

videos.title: The Fury is like scabies
videos.overview: As Parques' ambitions come to the fore, the Fury turns to Fehim for support. Not knowing whom she can trust, Lyna looks for her own form of back-up.

videos.title: Hello, my love
videos.overview: A prison visit results in a major encounter for Lyna, but her search for answers leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.

videos.title: Nature abhors a vacuum
videos.overview: Lyna tries to predict the masked attacker's next move but patience is wearing thin. Her desperation leads to a last ditch attempt to restore order.

videos.title: Where are the knives?
videos.overview: In the creeping shadows of a hostile forest, an unlikely alliance is formed as common enemies circle close, poised to swoop in for the kill.

videos.title: Namaste, asshole
videos.overview: A hazardous train ride brings the Arago family saga to an explosive conclusion. Yet when old lies are covered up with new ones, the rot still lingers.

videos.title: Picking up Strays
videos.overview: With a new order in charge of the underworld, the Furies turn to unlikely allies to help eliminate the organisation and take down its shadowy leader.

videos.title: How Do You Stop an Armored Van?
videos.overview: When an extraction mission attracts unwanted guests, Lyna struggles to keep her link with Elie a secret. Selma pays a visit to her old foe, The Carny.

videos.title: You Missed the Deal of the Century
videos.overview: With news that Oz is coming to town, the crew devises a plan of attack. Lyna vies for Varda's trust, while Selma targets a Damocles weapons delivery.

videos.title: A truce
videos.overview: The Furies' ploy sends Selma on the run, holed up by The Carny. As Lyna gains unprecedented access to Damocles, she's forced to face off with Orso.

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: As Lyna races through Paris, Selma makes her intentions clear about Oz — and anyone who stands in her way. A suspicious Elie places his trust in Iris.

videos.title: I Can Always Kill You Tomorrow
videos.overview: A grand plan unfolds as old allegiances crumble and unlikely bonds form. Refusing to accept the new order, Lyna prepares for one last fight.
